svg.title: V100 context benchmark at concurrency 2
svg.desc: Audited V100 context-scaling results for Qwen3.6 27B FP16 with DFlash, Qwen3.5 122B-A10B GPTQ Int4 with DFlash, and Laguna S 2.1 INT4 with and without DFlash.
svg.text: Qwen and Laguna DFlash · Laguna target-only baseline · 4× V100-SXM2-32GB · 256 output tokens/request
Decode is median per-request client-visible rate, not aggregate batch throughput. Input rate is prompt tokens / last client TTFT.
One audited cold-cache trial per cell · DFlash acceptance unsmoothed; target-only N/A · generated text retained · 2026-07-28
